title: Pre-Delivery Balance on the Riverbend Self-Pay Maternity & Delivery Package
content:
The pre-delivery balance is the part of a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery package the patient pays before delivery under Good Faith & Price Estimates, on request, as a prepayment held on the maternity estimate. The pre-delivery balance is paid no later than the type's balance-due days before the expected delivery date and may be paid earlier. Paying it is the patient's own act with their own card or bank account.

**Enrollment deposit on the package.** The pre-delivery balance is not fixed until an enrollment deposit collection stands on the maternity booking. In record terms, while the package's deposit activity shows no enrollment deposit collection, the pre-delivery balance has no fixed amount.

## Payment tool

**Capability.** The patient pays, in person and with their own card or bank account, the pre-delivery balance on their Riverbend self-pay maternity and delivery package. One call records one pre-delivery-balance payment against that package: a new deposit collection of the stated amount is added to the package's deposit activity under a newly issued payment confirmation number, and the deposits held on the package rise by the same amount. The patient sees the confirmation number and the new deposits-held figure at once.

**How it is invoked.** `pay_maternity_delivery_balance_fb9f749b` is the patient's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `estimate_id` | Id class — the reference number of the patient's maternity and delivery package estimate, as listed by the estimate lookup for this patient. |
| `amount` | Fixed-format class — the pre-delivery balance the patient pays, in USD, 2 decimal places, positive magnitude (USD, 2 decimal places, positive magnitude); the value is rounded half-up to the cent when recorded, and an empty value is not accepted. |

**Return.** A text receipt `Payment accepted: deposit_txn_id=..., payment_reference=..., deposit_stage=..., amount=..., deposit_held_usd=...`, where `deposit_txn_id` is the reference number of the new deposit collection, `payment_reference` is the payment confirmation number issued for this payment (PMT- followed by 7 digits), `deposit_stage` is `BALANCE_BEFORE_SERVICE`, `amount` is the amount recorded in USD with 2 decimal places, and `deposit_held_usd` is the deposits now held on the package in USD with 2 decimal places. The receipt line beginning "Payment accepted" is the sign that the payment was recorded.
